Yes, you can waive the hold by replying to the weather hold email. If you do, the Plant Care Guarantee still applies, but cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered and DOA claims for it won't be accepted.

I can't promise a Friday delivery, though. Live plants only ship Monday-Wednesday, and delivery depends on your zone and shipping method (Standard is 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2, and 5-8 in Zone 3). If you tell me your order number and zone, I can tell you whether Friday is realistic, or I can escalate to a Support Lead if you need a firm answer.
